description: Check up to 1000 Vietnamese CCCD/CMND numbers in one call. Returns per-row results (same fields as the single-value tool) plus a summary of total, valid and invalid rows. Null, empty or non-string entries do not fail the call: they come back as failed rows (ok:false, error code EMPTY) and are counted in summary.invalid.

ids.description: Citizen ID numbers (max 1000); null or empty entries become failed rows

name: vn_id_parse_batch
title: Parse many citizen IDs
